SpaceX has achieved a major milestone in rocket technology by catching its Starship spacecraft mid-air using the giant mechanical arms of its Mechazilla launch tower. During the 15th test flight, the spacecraft returned safely to Earth after deploying 26 Starlink V3 satellites. However, the Super Heavy booster could not be recovered. Here's how the technology works and why it matters for future Moon and Mars missions.
